scripts.build: npm run prepare:brain && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.check: npm run check:architecture && npm test && npm run build && playwright test && npm run build:desktop && playwright test --config playwright.desktop.config.ts && npm run audit:public
scripts.test:e2e:outage: npm run build && node scripts/test-live.mjs tests/e2e/outage.live.spec.ts
scripts.build:desktop: npm run prepare:brain && npm run typecheck && node scripts/build-desktop.mjs
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build:desktop && playwright test --config playwright.desktop.config.ts
scripts.test:desktop:live: npm run build && npm run build:desktop && node scripts/test-desktop-live.mjs
